syncSegmentsEn.text: O Lord, You search the human heart. You alone know me deeply. I love You alone with all my heart and mind!
As Mary broke the jar of perfume and knelt at Your feet, so I ask You to receive my deepest love.
O Lord, You search the human heart. You alone know me deeply. I love You alone with all my heart and mind!
As Mary broke the jar of perfume and knelt at Your feet, so I ask You to receive my deepest love.
Lord, may my ways be steadfast in keeping Your statutes. I treasure all Your commands.
Lord, with all my heart, mind, and strength I love You, my God, and give You all my love.
